Assign eDNA sequences to reference taxa

Source: R/assignment.R
rb_assignment.Rd

Functions to assign amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) to a curated reference database using either exact sequence matching or BLASTn alignment.

  • rb_assign_edna(): Main wrapper for taxonomic assignment.

  • rb_assign_blastn(): Runs BLASTn against a reference database.

  • rb_exact_hits(): Finds exact sequence matches in the reference.

  • rb_score_assignments(): Resolves and scores assignment hits, handling ties.

  • rb_parse_blast_tabular(): Parses standard BLAST tabular output.

  • rb_build_species_matrix(): Aggregates ASV assignments into a species-by-sample matrix.

  • rb_read_fasta(): Reads a FASTA file into a data frame (used internally for ASV input).

Usage

rb_read_fasta(path)

rb_score_assignments(
  hits,
  min_identity = 99,
  min_coverage = 0.9,
  tie_bitscore = 0
)

rb_exact_hits(asvs, refs)

rb_parse_blast_tabular(path)

rb_assign_blastn(
  asv_fasta,
  refs,
  out_dir,
  min_identity,
  min_coverage,
  max_target_seqs = 100,
  blastn,
  makeblastdb
)

rb_assign_edna(
  asv_fasta,
  con = NULL,
  db_path = NULL,
  marker = NULL,
  qc_flag = "pass",
  method = c("blastn", "exact"),
  min_identity = 99,
  min_coverage = 0.9,
  max_target_seqs = 100,
  out_dir = tempfile("barcurateR_assign_"),
  blastn = "blastn",
  makeblastdb = "makeblastdb",
  table_name = "reference_final"
)

rb_build_species_matrix(
  assignment,
  asv_table,
  include_ambiguous = FALSE,
  unassigned = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Path to a BLAST tabular output file or FASTA file.

hits

A data frame of assignment hits (output from rb_assign_blastn or rb_exact_hits).

min_identity

Minimum percent identity for a confident assignment.

min_coverage

Minimum coverage threshold. In rb_assign_blast(), this is applied as a pre-filter on query coverage (qcov). In rb_score_assignments(), it is applied to combined coverage (ccovs) for high/low confidence assignment. Applied as a proportion (e.g., 0.9 for 90%). Combined coverage is calculated as the geometric mean of query and subject coverage.

tie_bitscore

Tolerance for bitscore ties.

asvs

A data frame of ASVs (output from rb_read_fasta).

refs

A data frame of reference sequences.

asv_fasta

Path to a FASTA file containing ASV sequences.

out_dir

Directory for temporary BLASTn files.

max_target_seqs

Maximum number of target sequences to retain per ASV in BLASTn. Defaults to 100 to ensure that ties across many congeneric species are not prematurely dropped by the BLAST algorithm.

blastn

Path to the blastn executable.

makeblastdb

Path to the makeblastdb executable.

con

A DBI connection to a barcurateR SQLite database.

db_path

Path to the SQLite database (used if con is NULL).

marker

The marker gene to extract from the database (e.g., "12S", "COI").

qc_flag

Character vector of QC flags to include from the reference database (e.g., "pass", "manual_review_needed"). Passed to rb_get_sequences(). Defaults to "pass".

method

Assignment method: "blastn" (uses BLAST+) or "exact" (dependency-free exact matching mode).

table_name

Name of the reference table in the database (default "reference_final").

assignment

A data frame of scored assignments.

asv_table

A data frame of ASV counts per sample.

include_ambiguous

Logical. Include ambiguous and "check_full_tie" assignments in the matrix?

unassigned

Logical. Include unassigned ASVs (no_match) in the matrix?

Value

  • rb_assign_edna(), rb_assign_blastn(), rb_exact_hits(), and rb_score_assignments() return a data frame of scored assignments.

  • rb_parse_blast_tabular() and rb_read_fasta() return a parsed data frame.

  • rb_build_species_matrix() returns a species-by-sample abundance matrix.

Details

When method = "blastn", BLAST+ must be installed and blastn and makeblastdb must be available on the system path.

The assignment pipeline utilizes advanced alignment metrics to prevent common BLAST biases. It calculates subject coverage (scovs), combined coverage (ccovs = sqrt(qcov * scovs)), and bitscore per base (bitscore_pb). Hits are ranked using a robust hierarchy: -bitscore, -bitscore_pb, evalue, -ccovs, -pident.

The assignment_status column classifies the result:

  • "unique": A single best species match.

  • "ambiguous": Multiple species tied, but with slight metric variations.

  • "check_full_tie": Multiple species tied with perfectly identical top metrics across the board, requiring manual biogeographical or taxonomic curation.

  • "no_match": No hits passed the coverage/identity filters.

For ties, the tie_taxa column contains a pipe-separated (|) string of the tied species names (e.g., "Species A|Species B"). If there is no tie, this column is NA.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Assign ASVs using exact matching (no BLAST+ required)
assignment <- rb_assign_edna(
  asv_fasta = "asvs.fasta",
  db_path = "curated_ref.db",
  marker = "12S",
  method = "exact"
)

# Build a species-by-sample matrix
asv_counts <- read.csv("asv_table.csv")
species_matrix <- rb_build_species_matrix(assignment, asv_counts)
} # }
